notes: Prospective randomised study at the First Affiliated Hospital of Kunming Medical University and the Affiliated Hospital of Yunnan University, China (December 2019 to December 2021); 308 myopic children aged 8-12 years randomised 154/154 to orthokeratology or single-vision spectacles for 12 months, followed by a 1-month withdrawal; 279 completed the 13-month follow-up (Orth-K 142, SVS 137).
Table 1 (baseline characteristics) is headed n = 142 and n = 137, so the analysis set is the completers; Table 2 prints no n and is assumed to cover the same set.
Internal inconsistency: Table 1 and Table 2 give different baseline axial lengths for the same groups; Table 2 is cited because it holds the baseline and the follow-ups of the same series.
Device: IOLMaster 700 (Carl Zeiss). Units: millimetres (Table 2 caption 'AL levels (mm)'). Eye(s) analysed are not stated.
Spherical equivalent refraction, central corneal thickness, anterior chamber depth and central lens thickness are tabulated and not extracted.
